title: PROJECT.md — Document Q&A SaaS
summary: Product brief for a document-forward RAG SaaS defining v1 milestone scope, pillars (citations, chunking, UI polish), constraints, and success criteria.
notes: Strong PRD signals: product intent, milestone goals, success criteria, out-of-scope list, user-facing pillars.
